a2a_sync_system.name: Agent-to-Agent Synchronization via OmniRoute

components.sync_protocol: WebSocket + REST hybrid for A2A state sync
components.state_layer: PostgreSQL-backed event log for agent handoffs

flow: 1. Agent A (Maker) creates computer-use session → Kimi CLI
2. cmux manages session isolation + concurrency limits
4. Agent B (Checker) receives via OmniRoute → attaches to session
5. cmux switches context → Agent B control
6. State persisted to PostgreSQL for recovery/audit
